senses.sense_definition: De angst om tekort te schieten of fouten te maken in situaties waarin men beoordeeld wordt.

examples.text: Veel studenten hebben last van <w>faalangst</w> vlak voor hun eindexamens.

target_lang_translations.en: Many students suffer from <w>fear of failure</w> just before their final exams.

examples.text: Vaak verhindert <w>faalangst</w> dat mensen iets nieuws ondernemen uit angst om te falen.

target_lang_translations.en: Often <w>performance anxiety</w> prevents people from undertaking something new for fear of failing.

target_lang_definitions.en: The fear of falling short or making mistakes in situations where one is being judged.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: general term for the anxiety of not succeeding
specifically related to being judged or performing a task
specifically in the context of exams or assessments

senses.sense_definition: Een psychologische term voor de ziekelijke vrees om te falen.

examples.text: In de klinische psychologie wordt <w>faalangst</w> soms aangeduid met de term atychifobie.

target_lang_translations.en: In clinical psychology, <w>fear of failure</w> is sometimes referred to by the term atychiphobia.

examples.text: Zijn <w>faalangst</w> was zo ernstig dat hij professionele hulp nodig had om weer te kunnen functioneren.

target_lang_translations.en: His <w>atychiphobia</w> was so severe that he needed professional help to be able to function again.

target_lang_definitions.en: A psychological term for the pathological or morbid fear of failing.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: the clinical or technical term for fear of failure
the common name for the psychological condition
